messages:
Lena: FYI - OrinTech wants a short hosted API burst for their PoC next Wed 09:15-09:40 PT. Theyll run a synthetic client harness (approx 150 clients, ~8 rps each). Can we supply a scoped key + temporary quota bump and IP allowlist? Org id: org-orin-77.
Diego: What model + avg response size? Need to convert to tokens/sec to size the window safely.
Lena: Using redwood-2.0-medium on /v1/generate. Avg payload ~320 tokens (prompt+response). Ballpark: 150 * 8 * 320 = 384,000 tokens/min peak. Would like cushion -> request 450k tokens/min for a 30m window.
Kai: Capacity note  384k/min ~6.4k tokens/sec. Us-west-2 hosted pool can handle this for 30m if we reserve; I'll schedule a reservation but need exact UTC window. Also recommend adding a per-key concurrent request cap to reduce head-of-line issues.
Asha: Security checklist: scoped key only (no org-wide access), IP allowlist required, redact prompts from long-term logs, set retention 3 days for this key, and disable exports. Also need named contact for data retention questions.
Diego: Operational suggestion: set routing_policy with a graceful fallback to redwood-1.3-small and a header X-Redwood-ModelReturned so OrinTech can correlate. Recommend token_quota_per_minute=450000 and concurrent_request_limit=200. Valid window: 2026-05-12T16:15:00Z/2026-05-12T16:45:00Z (30m).
Lena: Contact is emma@orinte.ch. Ill DM IP ranges tonight. If we can approve now thatd be great.
Kai: I can create scoped key and pin routing. Sample API call Ill run (admin-only):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"org_id":"org-orin-77","name":"orintech-poc-burst","scopes":["gen:invoke"],"token_quota_per_minute":"450000","concurrent_request_limit":"200","valid_window":"2026-05-12T16:15:00Z/2026-05-12T16:45:00Z","routing_policy":{"fallback_model":"redwood-1.3-small","add_response_header":"X-Redwood-ModelReturned"}}'
```
op-bot: ACTION: reserved capacity on pool us-west-2 for tag "orintech-poc-burst" (ticket INF-4997)  reserved 800 rps equivalent.
Kai: Key will be created once IPs arrive; Ill also attach an observability alert: alarm if 5xx > 0.8% for 5m OR median latency > 500ms. Well automatically throttle the key if impacts detected.
Asha: Please ensure logs mask fields: prompt_text, user_email. Retention 72h. Ill sign off once IPs and contact confirmed.
Lena: IP ranges sent to Kai via DM. Thanks team  please share the scoped key when ready and monitor the dashboard.
Kai: Scoped key created: sk_orin_poc_5512. Token quota=450000/min, concurrent cap=200, retention=72h, fallback set. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/poc/orin-5512.
Diego: I'll join monitoring during the window and coordinate rollback if we see elevated error rates.
Lena: Awesome  closing the loop after the test and will post metrics. Appreciate the fast turnaround :tada:
